Tested locally in [3D Platformer](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/tree/master/3d/platformer)'s `player.tscn`, I noticed some issues:

- The cursor offset is incorrect when scrubbing the timeline, and playback shortcuts have no effect:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9adc5e82-f7a0-4be0-b6dc-674b2daf8554

- I got a crash when using **Scene > Reload Saved Scene** after making some unsaved changes in the animation editor:
